title: Holy company washes deeper than self-scrubbing
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 188
summary: The shabad opens by calling the sight of the saints a perfect cleansing bath. It moves through ego falling away, the One becoming visible everywhere, and the heart being irrigated with Naam.
whyItMatters: This is for the person trying to clean themselves with effort while envy, ego, and the five passions keep returning. Held faithfully, it turns cleansing from private labor into grace received in holy company.
takeaway: Seek the company that washes the heart and turns it toward Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਅਘ ਕੋਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t kee dhoor miTe agh koT ||
lines.translation: Millions of sins are wiped away by the dust of the feet of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaadh janam maran te chhoT ||1||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from birth and death. ||1||
The Blessed Vision of the Saints is the perfect cleansing bath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t kirapaa te japeeaai naam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, one comes to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
In the Society of the Saints, egotism is shed,
and the One Lord is seen everywhere. ||2||
By the pleasure of the Saints, the five passions are overpowered,
and the heart is irrigated with the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak jaa kaa pooraa karam ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, one whose karma is perfect,
touches the feet of the Holy. ||4||46||115||

structure: It opens by naming saintly presence itself as a complete cleansing.
The middle shows what that cleansing does: ego thins, the One is seen, and the passions lose ground.
It ends with perfect karma expressed as meeting the feet of the holy.
